title: Budget, idle resources and cloud cost
content: A cloud budget alert is not a billing cap. Count failed attempts, pending reservations and resource lifetime overhead, including NAT gateways and public IPs after compute stops. Unknown prices or stale reconciliation block another paid batch. Keep a cleanup reserve, export actual usage and verify exact approved resources stopped, deleted or deliberately retained. Credits are not engineering savings.
check: Reconcile pending reservations, complete resource inventory and forecast against the approved budget and cleanup reserve before further cloud work.
